strings.dv.mapNone: Die Veranstalter haben den genauen Ort dieser Veranstaltung noch nicht bekannt gegeben, daher wird keine Karte angezeigt.
strings.dv.notice: Diese Veranstaltung kehrt jährlich in ihrer ungefähren Saison wieder. Termine und Einzelheiten können von Jahr zu Jahr abweichen. Bitte bestätigen Sie sie vor Ihrem Besuch anhand der Ankündigungen der Veranstalter.
strings.ev.lomi.intro: Die Hasawi-Lomi-Ausstellung – auch als Hasawi-Limetten-Ausstellung bekannt – ist Al-Ahsas bedeutendste saisonale landwirtschaftliche Veranstaltung. Die Al-Ahsa-Handelskammer veranstaltet sie zu Ehren des berühmtesten landwirtschaftlichen Erzeugnisses der Oase nach den Datteln. Die Ausstellung bietet ein interaktives Erlebnis rund um die Eigenschaften, den Nutzen und den Anbau der Lomi (die Hasawi-Limette), direkten Kontakt zu den Landwirten und Einkaufsmöglichkeiten an den Ständen produktiver Familien. Dazu kommt das Begleitprogramm.
strings.ev.lomi.sec0.p0: Die Hasawi-Lomi ist eine kleine, dunkelgrüne Zitrusfrucht mit dünner Schale, reichlich Saft, kräftig-saurem Geschmack und einem unverwechselbaren Duft, der sie von anderen Zitrusfrüchten unterscheidet. Sie ist das zweite landwirtschaftliche Erzeugnis Al-Ahsas nach den Datteln: In der Oase stehen mehr als 100.000 tragende Lomi-Bäume, von denen jeder rund 25–30 kg pro Saison liefert.
strings.ev.lomi.sec0.p1: Ein liebgewonnener Hasawi-Sommerbrauch rankt sich um sie: Familien kommen zusammen, um sie für das ganze Jahr zu pressen und haltbar zu machen – frisch, als Saft oder getrocknet als „Jameed“ (die sonnengetrocknete Limette) für die Hasawi- und Golfküche.
strings.ev.lomi.faq1.a: Im Al-Ahsa-Ausstellungszentrum, Al-Salam-Straße (Ain-Najm-Straße), Hofuf – die Karte finden Sie auf dieser Seite.
strings.ev.lomi.faq4.q: Wodurch unterscheidet sich die Hasawi-Lomi von einer gewöhnlichen Zitrone?
strings.ev.lomi.faq4.a: Sie ist kleiner, dünnschaliger, saftiger und aromatischer und wird frisch, als Saft und getrocknet in der Hasawi-Küche verwendet.
strings.ev.lomi.faq5.a: Ja – die Ausstellung bietet eine Kinderecke, dazu Live-Kochvorführungen, landwirtschaftliche Workshops und familiäres Beisammensein.

strings.ev.lomi.after.seoDesc: Reiseführer zur Hasawi-Lomi-Ausstellung in Hofuf: ungefähre Saison jährlich im August–September – Termine der nächsten Ausgabe: siehe Al-Ahsa-Handelskammer.

termbase_additions.en: Hasawi Lemon Exhibition (alternative name of the Hasawi Lomi Exhibition)
termbase_additions.source: Compositional: Durchkopplung of the verified termbase entry 'Hasawi-Limette' (die) + generic Duden noun 'die Ausstellung' (https://www.duden.de/rechtschreibung/Ausstellung). Belegstelle: BATCH/pack.json ev.lomi.intro en ('also known as the Hasawi Lemon Exhibition'), arabische Autorität «ويُعرف أيضاً باسم معرض الليمون الحساوي».
termbase_additions.note: 'Lemon' rendert hier als 'Limette', nie 'Zitrone' — gebunden an die bestehende termbase-Regel für Lomi ('lime (lomi / Hasawi lime) → die Hasawi-Limette') und dieselbe Wahl wie im veröffentlichten Eintrag 'Hasawi Lemon Farm → die Hasawi-Limettenfarm'. Nur einmal verwendet, in ev.lomi.intro.

notes: FACT FENCE — dropped English's second alternative name: pack.json ev.lomi.intro (en) lists 'also known as the Hasawi Lemon Exhibition or the Al-Ahsa Lemon Festival', but the Arabic authority only carries one alternative name («ويُعرف أيضاً باسم معرض الليمون الحساوي» = Hasawi Lemon Exhibition). Per Arabic-wins/no-invention rule and the brief's explicit instruction to compare the alt-name lists, 'Al-Ahsa Lemon Festival' is omitted from ev.lomi.intro. Binding for later batches of this page.

FACT FENCE — dropped English's second alt-name in sec0.p0 too: en says 'often called the Hasawi lemon or Hasawi lime', ar only has «ويسمّيه كثيرون الليمون الأحسائي» (one name, lemon only). 'Hasawi lime' omitted per the same rule.

GLOSS PLACEMENT — this page's title (ev.lomi.name, verified) is 'Hasawi-Lomi-Ausstellung', i.e. titel_regel keeps 'Lomi' leading (unlike the lemon-farm page, whose title leads with 'Limette'). Per gloss_regel ('the form the title carries leads at first mention, the other sits in parentheses'), the gloss in ev.lomi.intro is 'der Lomi (die Hasawi-Limette)' — the REVERSE order of the published lemon-farm/fruits-page gloss. This is the correct, page-specific application of the same rule, not an inconsistency — flag for stage 4/7 confirmation.

GLOSS REPEAT REMOVED — because the termbase gloss for Lomi/Hasawi-Limette is set once in ev.lomi.intro (brief trap 5: 'gloss once here, don't repeat in sec0.p0'), the English clause in sec0.p0 restating alternative names ('often called the Hasawi lemon or Hasawi lime') — which is functionally a second gloss of the same equivalence — was compressed out of the German sec0.p0; it opens directly with 'Die Hasawi-Lomi ist eine kleine, dunkelgrüne Zitrusfrucht …'. No fact was lost: the name equivalence is already established in ev.lomi.intro on the same page.

ARABIC-ONLY DETAIL NOT ADDED — the Arabic authority of sec0.p0 carries a local-name parenthetical «(البن زهيري)» (Bin Zuhairi) that the English source omits entirely and that the brief's explicit alt-name trap does not call out. Left untranslated to avoid inventing beyond the pack's scope; flagged as an open question for the coordinator/judge whether it should be added (it already appears in the published /de/fruits/ card name 'Hasawi-Limette (Bin Zuhairi)').

JAMEED ADDED PER ARABIC AUTHORITY — sec0.p1's Arabic carries «الجميد» (Jameed) in parentheses; the English source omits it. Per the fact-fence rule (Arabic wins on divergence) and the brief's explicit prompt to check this, 'Jameed' was added to the German translation, reusing the exact published fruits-page wording „Jameed“ (die sonnengetrocknete Limette) — no new gloss coined.

dv.seasonK = 'Jahreszeit', NOT 'Saison' — the value shown under this label is an actual calendar season (Sommer/Winter), and batch-1's binding ruling reserves 'Jahreszeit' exclusively for the four calendar seasons while 'Saison' means the recurring event edition/window (badges, eyebrow, lead, ctaH, caption). Binding for later batches introducing the same fact-list label elsewhere on this page family.

dv.timeK = 'Zeitraum', reused verbatim from the already-approved ix.notes.0.h heading (same concept: an approximate timing window that must not promise a fixed date, unlike 'Termin'). Not a badge use, so does not conflict with the batch-1 ruling that reserves 'Zeitraum' from badge reuse.

ev.lomi.related.0.label uses the published short nav label 'Oasenfrüchte' (nav.fruits) rather than the page's full H1 'Saisonale Früchte Al-Ahsas' — shorter and closer to the English pattern ('our Fruits of Al-Ahsa page'). Flag for stage review if the full H1 is preferred instead.

ev.lomi.related.1.label = 'Reise planen' verbatim (the published nav.plan label), per the brief's explicit instruction to 'label it as the published German plan label' rather than compose a new sentence, since no German plan page exists yet and the link still targets the English page.

dv.back = 'Alle Termine', reusing the fixed, judge-confirmed page name 'Termine' for /de/events/ (nav.events/foot.l.events) — consistent with the standing decision that this page has exactly one German name.

Both carry only the approximate season 'August–September' (matching the approved ev.lomi.after.time) and the organiser's published name 'Al-Ahsa-Handelskammer' (ev.lomi.org) — no year, no dates, no tickets, per the brief's explicit instruction for the ended-edition state of this page.

ev.lomi.faq1.a and ev.lomi.faq5.a reuse the exact approved strings 'Al-Ahsa-Ausstellungszentrum, Al-Salam-Straße (Ain-Najm-Straße), Hofuf' (ev.lomi.place) and the four batch-4 activity names (Kinderecke, Live-Kochvorführungen, landwirtschaftliche Workshops, familiäres Beisammensein — ev.lomi.acts.3/1/2/4) verbatim, per the brief's explicit instructions.

STAGE 2 (Editor) — dv.notice: split the semicolon-joined sentence into two independent sentences ('… wieder; ihre Termine …' → '… wieder. Termine …') for better rhythm and to vary sentence length; dropped the redundant possessive 'ihre' on the new sentence. No fact, number or structure change.

STAGE 2 — ev.lomi.intro: replaced the passive participial clause '…, veranstaltet von der Al-Ahsa-Handelskammer …' with an active sentence 'Die Al-Ahsa-Handelskammer veranstaltet sie …' (Nominalstil/passive → Verb, per the editor brief). Also turned the trailing noun fragment ', dazu das Begleitprogramm.' into its own clause 'Dazu kommt das Begleitprogramm.' Same four elements (event description, organiser+purpose, three activities, accompanying programme), no fact added or removed — only reorganised into shorter, more natural sentences.

STAGE 2 — ev.lomi.sec0.p1: moved the „Jameed“ gloss to sit directly after 'getrocknet' (the specific preservation method it names) instead of dangling between 'haltbar zu machen' and the frisch/als Saft/getrocknet list, which read as an unattached aside. Same three preservation states (fresh/juice/dried) and the same Jameed gloss and parenthetical explanation — no fact change.

STAGE 2 — ev.lomi.faq4.q: per the orchestrator's binding correction, replaced the stage-1 verifier workaround 'von der gewöhnlichen Gartenzitrone' with the natural 'von einer gewöhnlichen Zitrone'. Verified directly against tools/verify-stage.mjs: the Zitrone/Limette guard (line ~116) explicitly does not fire when the key's EN source contains 'regular/ordinary/common lemon' — this key's source is 'a regular lemon' — so 'Zitrone' triggers no false positive here. The Hasawi lomi itself is still never called 'Zitrone' anywhere in this batch (it stays 'die Lomi'/'die Hasawi-Limette' throughout); only the ordinary lemon it is compared against is named 'Zitrone'. Closes the stage-1 note that flagged this for stage 4/7 review.

STAGE 2 — ev.lomi.after.seoDesc: inserted 'siehe' before the organiser name ('Termine der nächsten Ausgabe: siehe Al-Ahsa-Handelskammer.') — the bare colon-then-institution-name fragment juxtaposed 'next edition's dates' with 'Al-Ahsa-Handelskammer' with no stated relation between them. Adding the one-word verb form 'siehe' (common in German meta-description style) makes the fragment parse without lengthening it past budget (now 156 of ≤160 characters). No year, date or ticket fact added.
